## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

State the requested scope, the part completed here and any remaining work. Do not equate a gap inventory or partial detail pass with a completed digital twin.

## Evidence

For visual changes, include before/after images and identify browser screenshots or Blender renders. For neighborhood corrections, link dated sources and note any estimates.

Identify the building/street and relevant storefront or elevation records. Keep photographic observation, current business evidence and measured dimensions distinct. Preserve credits and photo provenance.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran, including `npm run verify` when applicable, and the browser/device used for hands-on checks. Note any remaining limitations.

For ongoing project sessions, refresh `CODEX-HANDOFF.md` and `SESSION-LOG.md` with the gameplay/source commit, local changes, push/deployment state and next authorized action. Keep historical check results separate from checks performed for this change.
